analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI failed to exit oversold, MACD histogram continued to worsen. ADX at 30.7 indicates strong trend, but -DI is above +DI, suggesting downward pressure. Low trading volume hinders directional confirmation.
analysis.narrative:
[추세 위치]
· 현재가(60,380원) vs SMA5(57,888원)/SMA20(67,812원)/SMA50(90,834원): 단기 SMA5 상회하나 중단기 SMA20/50 하회, 약세 구간.
· SMA100(113,945원)/SMA200(113,034원) 대비 현저히 낮은 위치: 중장기 추세 약화.
· 52주 위치(10.5%) + 현 가격대 역사적 저점 부근.
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (39.3→37.3): 과매도 탈출 실패, 중립 구간 하락.
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (916.1712→-277.2639): 악화 지속, 약세 수렴.
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 67,812원): 중단 부근 횡보, 밴드폭 41.16%로 변동성 확대.
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 (41,000원): 52주 저가 및 피벗 S1(46,358원) 기반.
· 스윙 저항선 (80,380원): 피벗 R1(79,108원) 및 5일 고가(68,000원) 상회 시 저항.
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴: 횡보, 추세 전환 신호 미발생.
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.46): 5일 평균 대비 위축, 움직임 신뢰도 하락.
· 현 구간 진단: 하락 추세 속 약한 반등 시도 후 재차 하락 압력 우세, 관망 조건 유지.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (60,380 KRW) vs SMA5 (57,888 KRW)/SMA20 (67,812 KRW)/SMA50 (90,834 KRW): Above short-term SMA5 but below mid-term SMA20/SMA50, indicating a weak zone.
· Significantly below SMA100 (113,945 KRW)/SMA200 (113,034 KRW): Long-term trend weakening.
· 52-week position (10.5%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.3→37.3): Failed to exit oversold, declining in neutral territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (916.1712→-277.2639): Continued worsening, bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 67,812 KRW): Sideways near the mid-band, bandwidth at 41.16% indicates expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (41,000 KRW): Based on 52-week low and Pivot S1 (46,358 KRW).
· Swing resistance (80,380 KRW): Resistance if price breaks above Pivot R1 (79,108 KRW) and 5-day high (68,000 KRW).
· 5-day/20-day high/low patterns: Sideways, no trend reversal signals.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.46): Below 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Bearish trend with weak rebound attempts followed by renewed downward pressure, maintaining conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
